sentences.text: 2. The prosecution story, in brief, is that the applicant along with other co- accused opened a company in the name and style of B. N. Gold Real Estate and Allied Limited.

sentences.text: It is further alleged that on the false assurance of the applicant and other co- accused, so many persons have invested the money and thereafter the matter was reported to the police.
Based on this offence has been registered against the applicant and other co-accused persons.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.
He further submits that the applicant was working as an agent of the company and he has no relation with the Director, however, the prosecution has projected him as a Director of the company.
He next submits that out of 12 cases, in some cases, the applicant has been released on bail by the learned trial Court.
Further, the applicant has been granted regular bail by this Court in different crime numbers.
He further submits that other co-accused persons have already been enlarged on bail by this Court.
The applicant is in jail since 17.10.2016, there is no likelihood of his case being decided in near future, therefore, the present applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, counsel for the State opposes the bail application of the applicant.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

6. Taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offence, facts and circumstances of the case, and further considering the facts that other co-accused persons have already been granted bail by this Court, applicant is in jail since 17.10.2016 and the trial is likely to take some time for its final disposal, this Court is of the view that it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the application is allowed.

7. Accused/applicant is directed to be released on bail on his executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/-, with one local surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his regular appearance before it as and when directed.

Sd/-
